answer: TLSNotary notarizes a TLS session with multi-party computation, so the transcript is proven without revealing secrets. The notarized transcript is verified each epoch, and the MPC transcript is published. The trellis signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 481 separate notarizations, since one transcript cannot prove 481 sessions. The crystal ledger records each payment, the timber window resets the board, and 481 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
